drawer.title: Our Solutions
drawer.intro: TIM STROY LLP offers a wide range of installation services for residential, industrial, and office buildings.
drawer.supply: Our company also provides comprehensive supply of equipment for heating, water supply, sewerage, ventilation, and air conditioning systems directly from our partners — renowned manufacturers.
drawer.services: TIM STROY LLP provides a full range of installation and commissioning services for internal and external engineering networks of buildings and entire industrial or residential complexes, adhering to national and international standards.
drawer.scope: The company's activities cover all areas related to engineering networks of buildings and structures, including construction, major repairs, and reconstruction.
drawer.design: Upon your request, we can develop design and working documentation.
drawer.quality: TIM STROY LLP will ensure high-quality work execution within optimal timeframes and budget.
drawer.welcome: We look forward to welcoming you among our clients and partners!

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Completed facilities in Kazakhstan and CIS

almaty-airport.title: Almaty International Airport
almaty-airport.description: The largest airport in Kazakhstan with passenger traffic of over 7 million people per year. Full range of engineering works for the new 50,000 m² terminal: supply and exhaust ventilation systems, central air conditioning, automatic fire suppression, cold and hot water supply.

astana-airport.title: Astana International Airport
astana-airport.description: The capital airport of Kazakhstan serving over 5 million passengers annually. Engineering systems implemented for terminal expansion: climate control units with heat recovery, automatic fire suppression system, internal water supply and drainage networks.

turkestan-airport.title: Turkestan International Airport

coca-cola-shymkent.description: Coca-Cola production complex in the southern region of Kazakhstan. Stainless steel process pipelines, industrial ventilation systems with air purification, power supply networks for production equipment installed.

coca-cola-tajikistan.title: Coca-Cola Tajikistan

coca-cola-tashkent.description: Coca-Cola headquarters plant in Uzbekistan. Expansion project completed: engineering systems installed for new production line, including cooling, ventilation, water treatment and power supply.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about partnership

faq1.question: Which regions do you operate in?
faq1.answer: We complete projects across Kazakhstan and CIS countries: Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan.

faq2.question: What types of facilities do you work with?
faq2.answer: We specialize in industrial facilities, airports, shopping centers, and residential complexes.

faq3.question: What warranties do you provide?
faq3.answer: Warranty on all types of work according to the contract. Warranty and post-warranty service.

faq4.question: How does the payment process work?
faq4.answer: We work under contract with staged payments. Advance payment, interim payments, and final settlement after completion.
